operating_goal: Continue QIF v0.6.x hardening with executable, domain-general runtimes that make AI-assisted quality discovery and agent actions traceable without claiming semantic truth.
next_value_slice: Implement QIF v0.6.26 Calibration Readiness CLI so humans, AI agents, and evaluators can determine whether current QIF evidence is ready to enter empirical calibration. The report must distinguish example or synthetic evidence from observed operational outcomes, identify missing decision-outcome pairs, suite-health evidence, domain diversity, uncertainty, and framework-learning evidence, and must never claim calibration from structure alone.
